verdict.rationale: Persona's API/webhooks return structured inquiry/verification statuses, decisioning, risk signals (watchlist, PEP, adverse media reports), and failure reasons, and workflows can auto-tag risk conditions for branching logic, with polling and webhook options for automated onboarding flows. missing for 10: no explicit documented schema/example of failure-reason codes or a worked agent-branching example, and no independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
